name: Replicator
tagline: Rebuilds a Grok bot as a ChatGPT Dot from a paste-ready kit
description: A migration tool between assistant platforms. It reads one of your Grok bots and rebuilds the equivalent setup as a ChatGPT Dot, producing a kit you can paste in yourself. If you are signed in on ChatGPT desktop it can apply the clone there too, though the paste kit works on its own.
author: monomyth
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
